reviewer: Codex visual inspection of the contact sheets and selected full-size outputs

rubric.identity: Recognizable as the reference character from visible face/hair/eyes. Back views without a clear face are unknown. No claim of exact facial geometry.
rubric.clothes: Coarse garment categories, primary colors and coverage. Unknown when cropped or skirt/shorts or tights/skin cannot be distinguished. Same does not mean identical trim, buttons or cut.
rubric.pose: Requested main body pose/object is clear. Framing, eye direction and fine anatomy are separate. The back-view prompt does not explicitly request full-body framing, so a crop is not itself a pose failure.
rubric.fine_details: Not calibrated. Visible coat cuts, trim, jacket fit and braids can change even when identity and coarse outfit match.

ratings.note: Different visible face/age; similar colors are not identity.
